item: Analytics 4-5 are looked at in Chromium (48 runs, fixtures) and the 390 px column cut-off it found is fixed
status: shipped (Chromium-verified in the remote sandbox on fixture rows; real rows await the operator's walk)
key_paths: scripts/analytics45_seed.py; scripts/analytics45_look.py; tests/test_analytics45_seed.py; src/static/app.css; docs/audit/analytics45-look-2026-10-12/; docs/product/RELEASE_0.5_GATE.md
summary: R126's walk for S4: 48 runs (1440x900, 768x1024, 390x844 x 15 theme settings in English, plus Arabic at the first theme) on an offline loopback app (online:false asserted per context and at the end of each run), every drop-down in the Wikipedia panel picked and read back, each figure of both readers judged against a seeded state's own truth: 1,299 checks, 0 failed, 0 console lines, 0 CSP events, 0 requests off the loopback origin. It found one real defect: at 390 px the two tables were 24 and 48 px wider than their frame, cutting the last column off behind a sideways scroll the page did not show; one 480 px padding rule fixes it (316 px in a 316 px frame, both languages). The UX pass for these two readers is closed; the clause 'render from real rows' is not (the rows are the seed's).
